name: store_reuse_rebuild_tlx
description: P1-2 tensormap reuse (tests/e2e/kernels/lkv_e2e_store_reuse_tlx.py `rebuild`): each work item rebuilds an in-kernel descriptor in the CTA's scratch slot and TMA-stores one 64x64 fp16 tile through it, ITEMS = columns / 64. rebuild_race: the rebuild precedes every wait of the item, so the previous item's store may still read the tensormap (P1-2 FAIL, F2); rebuild_drained: `cp.async.bulk.wait_group 0` + named barrier first (PASS); rebuild_read_drained: `cp.async.bulk.wait_group.read 0` + named barrier first (PASS: .read covers the tensormap read, PTX ISA); one_item: nothing to reuse (PASS). P0 must pass on every input (PTX translation). The legacy TTGIR translation (--frontend legacy) refuses tlx.named_barrier_wait (ttng.user_named_barrier_id); the PTX translation, the TLX/Triton default, also writes the P1-2 KIR.
